inventoryRule: operations must equal the routes actually registered by sourceModules (tests/contract/ws27-contracts.test.ts compares against Fastify onRoute).
sharedBehaviors: POST /v1/auth/register is the readiness-gated registration entry point and shares its body shape with the frozen POST /v1/auth/signup. Both call the same finalizeRegistration write path, so they cannot drift apart.

signup readiness is one predicate (registrationReadiness) shared by GET /v1/auth/config and POST /v1/auth/register: signupReady is advertised only when every required policy kind can be consented, the identity key is configured, SMS is configured and at least one social provider is configured. When not ready, registration is refused with 409 SIGNUP_NOT_READY and the reasons instead of failing later inside the write path.
Policy promotion is DRAFT -> READY only, one-way (the 004 integrity trigger seals the row). Promotion is never automatic: operator/effectiveAt/approvedAt/reason are explicit operator input.
Promotion requires a live ADMIN role grant and an ACTIVE (not restricted) member; every promoted document row is written to audit_log as POLICY_PROMOTED with kind/version/operator/timestamps.
POST /v1/auth/* is rate limited per client IP to 60 requests per minute (app-level hook) and answers 429 AUTH_RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After.
All routes respond with Cache-Control: no-store and X-Server-Time.

operations.notes: The ticket must already carry a verified phone (send/verify happen before registration on the frozen auth routes). nickname is generated by the server; gender/age-group are not collected.

errors.when: schema violation (unknown property such as nickname/status/verified, missing field, bad e-mail, bad ticket pattern)
TERMS or PRIVACY_CONSENT is absent from consents
ticket unknown, expired or already consumed
ticket has no verified phone digest
a required policy kind has no READY effective document
a consented version is no longer the current document, or expectedPolicyRevision does not match
the principal already has a non-withdrawn member
the principal is inside the 30-day rejoin wait
another live member already uses the verified phone
the phone belongs to a different principal
more than 60 POST /v1/auth/* requests per minute from one client IP

operations.notes: Promotes every policy_document row of the given version in one transaction. effectiveAt/approvedAt are parsed with Date and only checked for parseability; both are supplied by the operator.

errors.when: schema violation, unparseable effectiveAt/approvedAt, or blank operator
the operator's member is restricted or not ACTIVE
session is valid but has no live ADMIN role grant
no policy_document row exists for the version
at least one document of that version is already READY/RETIRED

openItems: Operator legal identity (민테크놀로지 / 권민택 / 549-87-02902 / 경기도 양주시 덕정길 81 / customer@mintech.ai) is product data for the policy bodies, not part of this interface contract. Wave-3 WS-22 writes the v0.2 bodies and loads them as DRAFT; promotion stays an explicit operator action.
This contract does not promote or approve any policy: no v0.2 document is made effective by registering the route.
The frozen POST /v1/auth/signup remains documented by contracts/auth-membership.v0.2.json; /v1/auth/register is the readiness-gated sibling with the same body shape.
